{{Quote|This place actually feels weirdly like home.''"<br />"''We haven't yet put explosives under all the floors to blow the place up when we leave. Then it becomes like home.|Voort saBinring and Jesmin Tainer|<ref name="MK" />}}
The '''Wraith Headquarters''' was a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]] used by the [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]]<ref name="MK" /> in [[44 ABY]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> during their [[Mission to Kuratooine|mission]] to prove the corrupt activities of [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]]. The base consisted of a cluster of old office prefabs on the cliffside overlooking an empty [[Kuratooine quarry complex|rock quarry]]. It was situated twenty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from the northeastern edge of [[Kura City]].<ref name="MK" /> 

[[Viull Gorsat]], the Wraith's assigned [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], established his lab in one of the outlying prefabs. [[Thaymes Fodrick]], who assumed computer and comm duties for the team, brought in a compact [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] and set it up in the largest building’s main room, which they dubbed the operations center. Fodrick also set up an elaborate computer-and-communications array in a corner of the same chamber. [[Trey Courser]], the Wraith in charge of equipment fabrication and maintenance, took over the prefab adjacent to Gorsat’s lab. Courser's prefab also served as an exercise floor. For security, the Wraiths' [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Huhunna]] rigged a hammock high in the trees near the buildings and then helped the [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Ranger]] [[Jesmin Tainer]] hide sensors at critical spots in the foliage around the area. Their assigned [[Medic/Legends|medic]], [[Drikall Bessarah]], chose one of the smaller prefabs as his quarters, which also served as their medical ward. The rest of the Wraiths chose their individual rooms in the same building as the operations center.<ref name="MK" />

The combined kitchen and dining space was dubbed as the [[Catastrophic Mess]] by the Wraiths.<ref name="MK" />
